{{Top|leg}}
A '''prismatic crystal''' or '''laser crystal''' was a type of precious stone used in the creation of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. The crystals were part of the weapon's [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuator]], and produced a high-energy beam of charged particles.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

They were often sought after by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
